title: Fix Unregistered Toolbar Group I18n Names
description: Fix toolbar group toggle IDs that have no corresponding i18n entries. The id compose.sketchpad.toolbar.group.selection/filter/etc has no i18n translation, causing raw IDs to show as tooltip labels. Also search for other similar unregistered IDs across the sketchpad UI.
